summary.headline: Palchus and the Chaldean Dodecaeteris
summary.text: Historical notice on Palchus’s apotelesmatic book, its Alexandrian and Smyrnaean responses, sources, and importance for ancient astrology, followed by an index of copies and editions of the Chaldean dodecaeteris, zodiacal kingdoms, and related astrological texts.
